--extra-index-url https://pypi.eng.aws.tenstorrent.com
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

# Experiment dependencies for the tt-crank tree (blacksmith/).
#
# tt-crank is installed FIRST (see install_tt_crank in env/activate) and its
# wheel metadata carries the pins this file has to live under:
#
#     torch@<cpu wheel URL>  click==8.1.7  pandas==2.3.3
#     pydantic==2.9.2        numpy>=1.24.4,<2  pyyaml>=5.4
#     loguru==0.6.0          seaborn==0.13.2   networkx==3.1
#     graphviz               websockets==16.0
#
# Those are deliberately NOT restated here -- one source of truth, in
# tt-crank/requirements.txt. This file adds only what the experiments need on
# top, pinned so the resolver never has to move one of the pins above.
# Keep `pip check` clean after changing anything here.

# tt-crank itself. Once tt-mlir CI publishes the wheel, pin it here exactly the
# way xla_requirements.txt pins pjrt-plugin-tt and drop the local build path.
# Until then `env/activate --crank` builds it from a local tt-mlir checkout --
# point TT_MLIR_HOME at one.
# tt-crank==0.1.0

# Matches tt-crank/requirements-dev.txt, which tracks transformers 5.x. (The
# tt-xla env's 4.57.1 pin is unrelated and does not apply here.)
transformers==5.12.1

# Upper-bounded by tt-crank's click==8.1.7:
#   huggingface-hub >= 1.17 requires click>=8.4.2; 1.16.1 has no click
#     dependency at all, and is >= the 1.5.0 transformers 5.12.1 asks for.
#   wandb >= 0.27 requires click>=8.2.0; 0.26.1 asks for click>=8.0.1.
# Raise both as soon as tt-crank's click pin moves -- they are held back by
# that pin, not by anything in blacksmith.
huggingface-hub==1.16.1
wandb==0.26.1

peft
datasets
tqdm
pytest

# NOTE: no torchvision here. It must match torch exactly (a mismatched build
# fails at import with "operator torchvision::nms does not exist"), and tt-crank
# pins torch by direct URL to the CPU wheel. Nothing in these experiments needs
# it; if a vision experiment is added, pin the matching CPU torchvision wheel by
# URL the way tt-crank/requirements-dev.txt does.
